mapper.sql: select p.price_id, p.sku_id, p.country_code, p.channel_code, p.currency_code, p.list_amount, p.sale_amount, p.effective_from, p.effective_to, p.status, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark, k.sku_code, s.default_name as spu_name from sku_price p left join product_sku k on k.sku_id = p.sku_id left join product_spu s on s.spu_id = k.spu_id
mapper.insert: insert into sku_price ( sku_id, country_code, channel_code, currency_code, list_amount, sale_amount, effective_from, effective_to, status, remark, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{skuId}, #{countryCode}, #{channelCode}, #{currencyCode}, #{listAmount}, #{saleAmount}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{effectiveTo}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
